verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a first-party way to schedule recurring jobs or workflows in Obsidian. Daily notes only opens or creates today's note when invoked. Headless Sync and the Obsidian URI are triggers or building blocks that would need an external scheduler. Plugins and the plugin API are developer primitives, not a built-in scheduler.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
